title: Simplicial spheres with $g_k=1$
summary: For $d\geq 4$, Kalai (1987) characterized all simplicial $(d-1)$-spheres with $g_2=0$, and for $k\geq 2$ and $d\geq 2k$, Murai and Nevo (2013) characterized all simplicial $(d-1)$-spheres with $g_k=0$. In addition, for $d\geq 4$, Nevo and Novinsky (2011) characterized all simplicial $(d-1)$-spheres with $g_2=1$. Motivated by these results, we characterize, for any $k\geq 2$ and $d\geq 2k+1$, all simplicial $(d-1)$-spheres with no missing faces of dimension larger than $d-k$ that satisfy $g_k=1$.
